item.title: Jang Dong-hyuk: "Abolishing Supplementary Investigation Rights Will Create Monster Police" (장동혁 “보완수사권 폐지 땐 괴물 경찰 탄생”)
item.description:
Jang Dong-hyuk: "Abolishing Supplementary Investigation Rights Will Create Monster Police" (장동혁 “보완수사권 폐지 땐 괴물 경찰 탄생”)

People Power Party leader Jang Dong-hyuk stated on the 14th regarding the Democratic Party of Korea's push for a revision to the Criminal Procedure Act, which aims to abolish the prosecution's supplementary investigation rights, that "as seen in the Jang Yun-gi case, handing over all investigative powers to the police and granting them absolute authority will create a monster police force." (국민의힘 장동혁 대표가 14일 더불어민주당이 검찰의 보완수사권 폐지를 골자로 하는 형사소송법 개정안을 추진하는 데 대해 “장윤기 사건에서 보듯 모든 수사권을 경찰에 넘겨주고 절대 권력을 부여하면 괴물 경찰이 탄생할 것”이라고 말했다.)

Attending the "Discussion on the Investigation Vacuum Revealed by the Jang Yun-gi Case and the Necessity of Supplementary Investigation Rights" held at the National Assembly in Yeouido, Seoul, that morning, Representative Jang said, "This is not a matter of political factions, nor is it a gift that can be lightly given to the hardline support base for a party convention for the sake of one person." He added, "That monster police will ultimately devour the lives and safety of the people." (장 대표는 이날 오전 서울 여의도 국회에서 열린 ‘장윤기 사건이 드러낸 수사 공백과 보완수사권의 필요성 토론회’에 참석해 “이건 정파의 문제도 아니고 어느 한 사람을 위해서 전당대회용으로 강성 지지층을 향해서 쉽게 내줄 수 있는 선물이 아니다”라며 이같이 밝혔다. 그러면서 “그 괴물 경찰은 결국 국민 생명과 안전을 집어삼키게 될 것”이라고 했다.)

"I have consistently voiced the need for prosecution reform, but this current situation is completely different," Jang said. "Looking at the Jang Yun-gi case, it's not only impossible to expect the police to conduct a proper investigation in good faith, but rather, what is needed now is a 'police reform' answer." He emphasized, "When the police wield vast powers, there must absolutely be someone to check and control them." (장 대표는 “저는 평소 검찰 개혁 필요성에 목소리를 내왔던 사람이지만, 지금 이 모습은 전혀 아니다”라며 “장윤기 사건을 보면 경찰에게 선의에 기대서 제대로 수사해 달라고 기대하는 것도 아예 불가능할 뿐 아니라 오히려 지금 필요한 것은 ‘경찰 개혁’이라는 답을 얻게 된다”라고 했다. 그러면서 “경찰이 거대한 권력을 행사함에 있어서 반드시 누군가 견제하고 통제할 필요성이 있다”고 했다.)

Chief of the Policy Committee Jeong Jeom-sik also stated, "The Jang Yun-gi case is an incident where the police, who should uncover the truth, instead turned a blind eye to it, concealed evidence, and betrayed the people." He added, "If even the prosecution's supplementary investigation rights are abolished, the minimum checks to prevent poor police investigations and abuse of investigative powers could be rendered ineffective." He stressed, "Supplementary investigation rights are not a system for the prosecution, but a system to protect the rights of the people and prevent unjust victims from emerging." (정점식 원내대표도 “장윤기 사건은 진실을 밝혀야 할 경찰이 오히려 진실을 외면하고 증거를 은폐하고 국민을 배신한 사건”이라고 했다. 그는 “검찰의 보완수사권마저 폐지된다면 경찰의 부실 수사와 수사권 남용을 막을 최소한의 견제 장치마저 무력화될 수 있다”며 “보완수사권은 검찰을 위한 제도가 아닌, 국민의 권리를 보호하고 억울한 피해자가 발생하는 것을 막기 위한 제도”라고 했다.)

Attending the discussion as participants were the victim of the Busan 'spin kick case' and lawyers Choi Chang-ho, Kim Jae-ryeon, and Kim Se-hee. (이날 토론회에는 부산 ‘돌려차기 사건’ 피해자와 최창호·김재련·김세희 변호사가 토론자로 참석했다.)

item.title: Song Young-gil: "Jung Cheong-rae at a stalker level toward President Lee... His non-candidacy declaration was also out of nowhere" (송영길 “정청래, 李 대통령 스토커 수준…대선 불출마도 뜬금없더라”)
item.description:
Song Young-gil: "Jung Cheong-rae at a stalker level toward President Lee... His non-candidacy declaration was also out of nowhere" (송영길 “정청래, 李 대통령 스토커 수준…대선 불출마도 뜬금없더라”)

Song Young-gil, a candidate for the leadership of the Democratic Party of Korea in the August 17th party convention, has described his rival, former leader Jung Cheong-rae, as "at a stalker level toward President Lee Jae-myung." Song also hit back at Jung's criticism of his own departure from the party and denial of the so-called 'Myung-Cheong conflict,' calling it "self-contradictory." (더불어민주당 8·17 전당대회 당권 주자인 송영길 의원이 경쟁자인 정청래 전 대표를 향해 “이재명 대통령 스토커 수준”이라고 말했다. 송 의원은 정 전 대표가 자신의 탈당 이력을 비판하고 이른바 ‘명청 갈등’을 부인한 데 대해서도 “자기모순”이라고 맞받았다.)

In a radio interview on the 14th, Song responded to Jung's statement from the previous day's candidacy declaration that "there is no Myung-Cheong conflict," saying, "Even if he keeps shouting Lee Jae-myung's name alone, without the other party liking or agreeing, does that make the Myung-Cheong confrontation disappear? That's what you call a stalker. It's almost at that level." (송 의원은 14일 한 라디오 방송에서 정 전 대표가 전날 출마 선언을 통해 “명청 갈등은 없다”는 취지로 말한 데 대해 “상대방이 좋아하지 않고 동의하지 않는데 혼자 이재명을 몇 번 외친다고 명청 대전이 없어지느냐”며 “그걸 스토커라고 한다. 거의 그런 수준”이라고 말했다.)

Song repeatedly raised the issue of the discord between the party and the presidential office during Jung's tenure, stating, "It's rare in constitutional history for a conflict between a president with four years left in office and the ruling party leader to become a major media topic." He criticized Jung's emphasis on a "party-government-presidential office one team" by repeatedly mentioning President Lee's name in his candidacy speech, arguing that Jung should reflect on his actual relationship with the presidential office. (송 의원은 “임기 4년이 남은 대통령과 집권당 대표의 갈등이 언론의 주요 주제가 되는 것은 헌정사에서 보기 어려운 일”이라며 정 전 대표 재임 기간 불거진 당·청 간 불협화음을 거듭 문제 삼았다. 정 전 대표가 출마 선언문에서 이 대통령의 이름을 여러 차례 언급하며 ‘당정청 원팀’을 강조한 데 대해서도 실제 대통령실과의 관계를 돌아봐야 한다는 취지로 비판했다.)

Song also took a sharp stance against Jung's declaration in his candidacy speech that he "will not use the party leader position to run for president." Song deemed it inappropriate to mention not running for president when the current administration still has about four years left, calling it "a strange, out-of-place story." (정 전 대표가 출마 선언에서 “당대표직을 이용해 대선에 출마하지 않겠다”고 밝힌 데 대해서도 날을 세웠다. 송 의원은 현 정부 임기가 4년가량 남은 상황에서 대선 불출마를 언급한 것 자체가 부적절하다며 “엇나가는 뜬금없는 이야기”라고 했다.)

Song pointed to Jung's explanation during last year's party convention, where Jung emphasized the importance of the early days of the Lee Jae-myung administration and chose a one-year term as party leader without authority over nominations. Song criticized Jung for now running in a party leadership election with nomination powers, arguing that it is inconsistent to portray that earlier choice as a sacrifice. (송 의원은 정 전 대표가 지난해 전당대회 당시 이재명 정부 출범 초기의 중요성을 강조하며 공천권이 없는 1년 임기의 당대표를 선택했다고 설명했던 점도 거론했다. 그는 당시 선택을 희생으로 내세웠던 정 전 대표가 다시 총선 공천권을 행사할 수 있는 당대표 선거에 출마한 것은 앞뒤가 맞지 않는다고 비판했다.)

Regarding Jung's emphasis on "party before self," Song claimed it was actually "self before party," prioritizing his own political goals. He argued that during the last presidential election, Jung's activities in the Honam region and the appointment of numerous special party advisors ahead of local elections were closer to building an organization for his own re-election rather than for the party's victory. However, this is Song's assessment, while Jung's side has maintained that these actions were aimed at securing election victories and strengthening the party organization. (정 전 대표가 강조한 ‘선당후사’에 대해서도 송 의원은 사실상 자신의 정치적 목적을 앞세운 ‘선청후당’이었다고 주장했다. 지난 대선 당시 호남 활동과 지방선거를 앞두고 임명한 다수의 당대표 특보가 당의 승리보다 연임을 준비하기 위한 조직 구축에 가까웠다는 것이다. 다만 이는 송 의원의 평가로, 정 전 대표 측은 그동안 당의 선거 승리와 조직 강화를 위한 활동이었다는 입장을 보여왔다.)

In response to Jung's criticism of his departure from the party, Song countered, "It was a departure to protect the Democratic Party." Song brought up the incident during the 2022 presidential election when Jung's so-called "Bongyi Kim Seon-dal" remarks sparked backlash from the Buddhist community, arguing that Jung should have taken more proactive measures to reduce the burden on the party and the presidential candidate. (자신의 탈당 이력을 문제 삼은 데 대해서는 “민주당을 지키기 위한 탈당이었다”고 반박했다. 송 의원은 2022년 대선을 앞두고 정 전 대표의 이른바 ‘봉이 김선달’ 발언으로 불교계 반발이 커졌던 일을 거론하며, 당시 정 전 대표가 당과 대선 후보의 부담을 줄이기 위해 보다 적극적인 조처를 했어야 한다는 취지로 말했다.)

Song has been on the offensive since Jung officially announced his candidacy on the 13th. In a radio interview that day, Song claimed that if the party entered the next general election under Jung's leadership, it would be a "certain defeat," and asserted that some party lawmakers share a sense of crisis that it would be difficult to win a general election with Jung's face. (송 의원은 정 전 대표가 출마를 공식 선언한 13일부터 집중 공세를 펴고 있다. 그는 13일 한 라디오 인터뷰에서 정 전 대표 체제로 차기 총선을 치를 경우 “필패”할 것이라며, 당내 일부 의원들 사이에서도 정 전 대표의 얼굴로는 총선을 치르기 어렵다는 위기의식이 있다고 주장했다.)

In another interview the same day, Song directly attacked Jung's statement about protecting President Lee, saying, "What does he think he is, to protect President Lee Jae-myung? You have to win the general election to protect him. Do you think you can win a general election with Jung Cheong-rae's face?" (같은 날 다른 인터뷰에서는 정 전 대표가 이 대통령을 지키겠다고 밝힌 데 대해 “자기가 뭔 이재명 대통령을 지키느냐. 총선에 이겨야 지킬 텐데 정청래 얼굴로 총선을 이길 것 같으냐”고 직격했다.)

Song also said on the YouTube channel Spix that if Jung leads the Democratic Party, "Even my daughter or son wouldn't vote for it." He described Jung's management of the party as "like a frog in a well," and argued that Jung should take responsibility for the local election results, step back for a while, and bring change to the party. (송 의원은 또 유튜브 채널 스픽스에서 정 전 대표 체제로 민주당을 이끌 경우 “우리 딸, 아들도 안 찍을 것”이라고 했다. 정 전 대표의 당 운영을 두고는 “우물 안 개구리 같았다”며, 지방선거 결과에 책임을 지고 한 차례 쉬면서 당에 변화를 줘야 한다고 주장했다.)

The competition among party leadership candidates is also intertwined with the supreme council member election. Observers inside and outside the party note that candidates like Kim Young-ho and Park Sun-won, who are running for the supreme council, are classified as being close to Song, raising the possibility that they could effectively serve as running mates. <<>> (당대표 후보 간 경쟁은 최고위원 선거와도 맞물리는 양상이다. 당 안팎에서는 최고위원 선거에 출마한 김영호·박선원 의원 등이 송 의원과 가까운 후보군으로 분류되며 사실상 러닝메이트 역할을 할 가능성이 거론된다.)

item.title: Lee: "The age for juvenile offenders should be lowered, but by one year seems insufficient..." (李, 촉법소년 연령 “낮추긴 낮춰야, 한살은 부족한것 같기도...”)
item.description:
Lee: "The age for juvenile offenders should be lowered, but by one year seems insufficient..." (李, 촉법소년 연령 “낮추긴 낮춰야, 한살은 부족한것 같기도...”)

President Lee Jae-myung stated on the 14th regarding the age of "juvenile offenders" who are exempt from criminal punishment, "It seems we do need to lower it." He suggested that the current age range of 10 to under 14 years old for juvenile offenders should be adjusted to lower the upper limit from 14 to 13 years old. (이재명 대통령은 14일 형사처벌을 받지 않는 ‘촉법소년’ 연령에 대해 “낮추긴 낮춰야 할 것 같다”고 말했다. 현재 만 10세 이상~14세 미만인 촉법소년 연령에서 14세를 13세 이하로 낮추는 게 필요하다는 것이다.)

President Lee received a report on the "results of public deliberation on the age standard for juvenile offenders" from the Ministry of Gender Equality and Family during a Cabinet meeting held at the presidential office that day. The Ministry reported that the conclusion of the public deliberation was to lower the age from "under 14 years old" to "under 13 years old" but only for serious, major, or repeat offenses. (이 대통령은 이날 청와대에서 열린 국무회의에서 성평등가족부로부터 ‘촉법소년 연령 기준 공론화 결과’를 보고받았다. 성평등가족부는 강력·중대·반복 범죄에 한해 ‘만 14세 미만’을 ‘만 13세 미만’으로 낮추는 안을 공론화 결론으로 보고했다.)

President Lee, assuming that a certain level of consensus exists on lowering the age for juvenile offenders, stated, "The Ministry of Gender Equality and Family's opinion suggests not lowering it uniformly but only partially lowering it by one year for specific crimes—doesn't that seem too insufficient? Aren't there quite a few countries worldwide that set it at 12 years old?" (이 대통령은 촉법소년 연령을 낮추는 방향에 대한 공감대는 어느 정도 형성되어 있다는 것을 전제로 “성평등가족부 의견은 일률적으로 낮추지 말고 특정 범죄에 대해서만 부분적으로 한 살 낮추자는 말인데 너무 미약하지 않나”라며 “전 세계적으로 12세로 하는 경우도 꽤 많지 않느냐”라고 했다.)

President Lee added, "The issue is how many years to uniformly lower it. Lowering it uniformly by two or three years seems too excessive." However, he continued, "But what about serious crimes? For instance, can't a 12-year-old commit murder or a serious crime? A 12-year-old might exploit that." He also remarked, "I've seen in the media some sensational, extremely exceptional cases where offenders say, 'I won't get punished,' while committing crimes. Seeing that, doesn't it seem that lowering it by just one year is insufficient?" (이 대통령은 “문제는 일률적으로 몇 살까지 낮출 것이냐, 일률적으로 두세 살씩 낮추는 것은 너무 과한 것 같긴 하다”고 했다. 그러면서도 “중대 범죄에 대해서는 어떻게 할 것이냐”며 “예를 들어 열두 살인데 무슨 살인이나 중범죄를 저지를 수 있지 않나, 열두 살이 (그걸 알고) 이용할 수도 있겠고”라고 했다. 이 대통령은 “언론에서 약간 선정적으로 극히 예외적인 경우로 ‘나 처벌 안 받아’ 하면서 (범죄를) 저지르는 장면도 있더라”며 “그런 걸 보면 한 살 만으로 부족하지 않나”라고 했다.)

No final conclusion was reached at the Cabinet meeting that day. President Lee stated, "If we lower it, it seems the maximum would be two years. Let's not make a final decision today. Let's have another discussion within this range next time. Let's also gather more public opinions and conduct a survey." (이날 국무회의에서는 최종 결론은 나지 않았다. 이 대통령은 “낮춘다면 최대가 2년인 것 같다”며 “오늘 최종 결정은 하지 말고, 이 범위 내에서 다음에 한번 또 토론을 한번 하자. 국민 의견 수렴을 또 해보고 여론조사도 해보자”고 했다.)

During the meeting, President Lee also joked about the claims that circulated during past presidential elections that "Lee Jae-myung had been to a juvenile detention center as a child" in relation to the disposition of juvenile offenders. While juvenile offenders are not subject to criminal punishment, they do receive "protective dispositions," which can include being sent to a juvenile detention center. However, such records are not retained, so they do not affect later entry into public office. (이날 회의에선 이 대통령은 촉법소년이 받는 소년원 처분과 관련해 과거 대선 때 돌았던 ‘이재명이 어린 시절 소년원에 다녀왔다’는 주장에 대한 농담을 하기도 했다. 촉법소년의 경우, 형사처벌은 받지 않지만 소년원에 보내지는 ‘보호 처분’은 받는다. 하지만 기록이 남지 않아 이후 공직 진출 등에 영향을 받지는 않는다.)

Upon hearing that the records are not retained, President Lee laughed and said, "So that's why the story about 'Lee Jae-myung's juvenile detention center' came up—because the records are said to have disappeared." During the 2022 and last year's presidential elections, some YouTubers claimed that President Lee had committed crimes as a child and had been to a juvenile detention center. Some of them were investigated for spreading false information. item.title: “I’m Grateful for 30 Million Won, but Would 50 Million Won Be Okay?” Public Official Who Took Bribes Caught by the Board of Audit and Inspection (“3000만원 고마운데, 5000만원 정도까지 괜찮을까” 뇌물 받은 공직자 감사원에 적발)
item.description:
“I’m Grateful for 30 Million Won, but Would 50 Million Won Be Okay?” Public Official Who Took Bribes Caught by the Board of Audit and Inspection (“3000만원 고마운데, 5000만원 정도까지 괜찮을까” 뇌물 받은 공직자 감사원에 적발)

An executive at a public institution was caught by the Board of Audit and Inspection for receiving a bribe of 50 million won in exchange for awarding institutional contracts to a private company. (공공기관 간부가 민간 업체에 기관 일감을 주는 대가로 5000만원 뇌물을 받았다가 감사원에 적발됐다.)

According to the audit report on ‘Public Discipline Inspection’ published by the Board of Audit and Inspection on the 14th, Senior Researcher A at the Korea Institute of Civil Engineering and Building Technology was put in charge of overseeing a project in 2022 where the South Korean government, as part of Official Development Assistance (ODA), established a smart city construction technology cooperation center in Vietnam. (감사원이 14일 공개한 ‘공직 기강 점검’ 감사 보고서에 따르면, 한국건설기술연구원의 A 선임위원은 2022년 한국 정부가 공적 개발 원조(ODA)의 일환으로 베트남에 스마트 시티 건설 기술 협력 센터를 세워주는 사업을 총괄하게 됐다.)

While on a business trip to Vietnam in April 2022, A met with B, the local head of a private company he had gotten to know during a prior assignment in Vietnam. A demanded 30 million won, promising to help the company win the project. After receiving the company’s introduction document from B via a mobile messenger, A said, “It seems like we’ll have a lot to work on together.” (2022년 4월 베트남으로 출장을 간 A는 앞서 베트남 파견 근무 중 알게 된 한 민간 업체 현지 법인장 B와 만나 ‘업체가 사업을 수주할 수 있게 도와주겠다’며 3000만원을 요구했다. A는 B에게서 모바일 메신저로 업체 소개서를 전달받고는 “같이 할 일이 많을 듯하다”고 말하기도 했다.)

Before the tender notice was even issued for a portion of this project worth 1.94 billion won, A handed over undisclosed internal documents, including design specifications, to B on 19 separate occasions. After B’s company won the project in 2022, A sent B a message via KakaoTalk on October 4, 2022, claiming he had a large loan (700 million won) and demanded an additional 20 million won on top of the originally agreed 30 million won, totaling 50 million won. According to messages secured by the Board of Audit and Inspection, A said, “B, I’m a bit hesitant to say this, but I’m really grateful you’re giving me 3 million—just wondering if 5 million would be okay? I’ll keep it a secret until the day I die.” B responded, “Without you, this (winning the project) wouldn’t have been possible,” and agreed to the demand. (A는 이 사업의 일부분인 19억4000만원짜리 사업과 관련해 입찰 공고를 내기도 전에 B에게 설계 내역서 등 미공개 내부 자료를 19차례에 걸쳐 넘겨줬다. 이후 2022년 B의 업체가 사업을 수주하자, 2022년 10월 4일 B에게 카카오톡으로 메시지를 보내 자기가 받은 대출금(7억원)이 많다면서 기존에 약속한 3000만원에 2000만원을 더해 5000만원을 달라고 요구했다. 감사원이 확보한 메시지에 따르면, A는 “B야 이런 말 하기 조심스럽다만, 3천도 챙겨준다니 참 고마운데, 5천 정도까지 괜찮겠나 모든 건 죽을 때까지 비밀로 하고”라고 했다. B는 “너 아니면 이거(수주) 할 수도 없는 거”였다며 요구를 받아들였다.)

On October 18, 2022, via Telegram, A instructed B to send 50 million won to the account of C, a Vietnamese businessman known to A. The next day, after B sent 50 million won to C’s account, on October 21, A had C transfer 1 billion Vietnamese dong (about 50 million won) to the account of D, another Vietnamese businessman known to A. (A는 2022년 10월 18일 텔레그램을 통해 B에게 5000만원을 자기가 아는 베트남 사업가인 C의 계좌로 보내라고 했다. 이튿날 B가 C 계좌로 5000만원을 보내자, A는 10월 21일 C에게 자기가 아는 다른 베트남 사업가 D의 계좌로 10억동(약 5000만원)을 보내게 했다.)

The Board of Audit and Inspection could not confirm whether the money ultimately reached A because they were unable to investigate the Vietnamese bank accounts. However, based on the messages and phone call records exchanged between A and B, they determined that A had received 50 million won. (감사원은 이 돈이 최종적으로 A에게 갔는지는 베트남 은행 계좌를 조사할 수 없어 확인하지 못했으나, A와 B가 주고받은 메시지와 통화 내용 등을 바탕으로 A가 5000만원을 받았다고 판단했다.)

It was also revealed that A had received airfare and accommodation costs from other private company contacts to whom he had awarded institutional contracts. In September 2022, while traveling to Vietnam for a vacation, A prearranged with the head of a private company to provide airfare and accommodation, receiving round-trip tickets between Incheon and Hanoi worth 650,000 won. To another executive at a different company, A sent a KakaoTalk message saying, “Things like hotel reservations should be handled by the travel team,” while demanding hotel booking and payment. He had them pay 1.28 million won for 13 nights of hotel stay from October 3 to 15 of that year. The Board of Audit and Inspection found that A received a total of 2.53 million won in costs from three trips to Vietnam for vacations or business between September 2022 and March 2023. (A는 자기 기관 일감을 준 다른 민간 업체 관계자들에게서 항공료, 숙박비 등을 받은 것으로도 드러났다. A는 2022년 9월 휴가 목적으로 베트남으로 가면서 민간 업체 대표에게서 항공권과 숙박비를 제공받기로 미리 약속하고, 인천과 하노이 간 왕복 항공권 65만원을 받았다. 또 다른 업체 임원에게는 카카오톡으로 “호텔 예약하고 이런 거는 출장단이 하는 게 맞아요”라는 메시지를 보내면서 호텔 예약과 결제를 요구했고, 그해 10월 3일부터 15일까지 13일간 호텔에 묵은 비용 128만원을 대신 결제하게 했다. 감사원은 이런 식으로 A가 2022년 9월부터 이듬해 3월까지 세 차례 베트남으로 휴가나 출장을 다녀오면서 나온 비용 253만원을 받은 것으로 파악했다.)

A also received round-trip airfare worth 1.06 million won to Ho Chi Minh City in December 2024 from another Vietnamese company representative he had known since 2018. (A는 2018년부터 알고 지내던 다른 베트남 법인 대표에게 2024년 12월 106만원어치 호찌민 왕복 항공권을 제공받기도 했다.)

The Board of Audit and Inspection referred A to the prosecution on charges of bribery and violating the Anti-Corruption Act, and demanded the Korea Institute of Civil Engineering and Building Technology impose the highest-level disciplinary action of dismissal. (감사원은 A를 뇌물 수수와 청탁금지법 위반 혐의로 검찰에 고발하고, 한국건설기술연구원에는 최고 수위인 해임 징계를 요구했다.)

Meanwhile, a Grade 5 civil servant at the National Data Agency (formerly Statistics Korea) was also found to have received 5 million won from a private company and other work-related individuals in exchange for awarding projects worth 939 million won. The Board of Audit and Inspection demanded the Data Agency demote this official. (한편 국가데이터처(옛 통계청) 5급 공무원도 9억3900만원짜리 일감을 준 민간 업체 등 직무 관련자로부터 500만원을 받은 것으로 드러났다. 감사원은 데이터처에 이 공무원을 강등하라고 요구했다.)

item.title: Joo Jin-woo: "National Election Commission Pushes 17 Billion Won Worth of Contracts to Ex-Officials' Family Companies... 'Election Mafia Cartel'" (주진우 “선관위, 전관 가족회사에 170억원대 일감 몰아줘...‘선피아 카르텔’”)
item.description:
Joo Jin-woo: "National Election Commission Pushes 17 Billion Won Worth of Contracts to Ex-Officials' Family Companies... 'Election Mafia Cartel'" (주진우 “선관위, 전관 가족회사에 170억원대 일감 몰아줘...‘선피아 카르텔’”)

Allegations surfaced on the 17th that the National Election Commission (NEC) funneled approximately 17 billion won worth of contracts to family-run businesses of former employees. (중앙선거관리위원회가 전 직원의 가족회사에 170억원대 일감을 몰아줬다는 의혹이 17일 제기됐다.)

According to data obtained from the NEC and other sources by Representative Joo Jin-woo of the People Power Party, three companies associated with A, a former head of the NEC's political party division, along with their spouse and son, signed a total of 103 contracts with the NEC. Of these, 90 were awarded through negotiated contracts, amounting to a total of 17.5 billion won. (주진우 국민의힘 의원이 선관위 등으로부터 확보한 자료에 따르면, 중앙선관위 정당과장 출신 A씨와 배우자·아들이 관련된 3개 업체는 선관위와 총 103건의 계약을 체결했다. 이 중 90건은 수의계약으로 이뤄졌다. 총 175억원 규모다.)

Company B, where A serves as CEO, had only three employees but secured 66 contracts with the NEC worth a total of 2.9752 billion won. This company also supplied the controversial 'semi-transparent in-district early voting booths' during the June 3 local elections. (A씨가 대표이사로 있는 B사의 경우 직원이 단 3명에 불과했지만, 선관위와 66건, 총 29억7520만 원 규모의 계약을 맺었다. 이 업체는 6·3 지방선거에서 논란이 된 ‘반투명 관내 사전투표함’도 납품했다.)

Company C, whose CEO is A's spouse, signed 9 contracts with the NEC totaling 409.45 million won, of which 8 were negotiated contracts. Companies B and C were located on the same floor of the same building, and A also served as an auditor for Company C. (A 씨의 배우자가 대표이사인 C사는 선관위와 9건, 총 4억945만원 규모의 계약을 체결했다. 이 가운데 8건이 수의계약이었다. B사와 C사는 같은 건물·같은 층에 있었고, A씨는 C사의 감사를 맡기도 했다.)

Additionally, Company D, where A served as an internal director, signed 28 contracts with the NEC totaling 14.16858 billion won, with 18 of these being negotiated contracts. (또 A 씨가 사내이사로 참여한 D사는 선관위와 28건, 총141억6858만원 규모의 계약을 체결했다. 이 중 18건이 수의계약으로 나타났다.)

Representative Joo stated, "This is the reality of the 'Election Mafia (Election Commission + Mafia) cartel,' which even handed out contracts to former officials and their family companies," adding, "Given the risk of evidence tampering, a special counsel investigation should be launched immediately." (주 의원은 “전관과 가족회사에 일감까지 몰아준 ‘선피아(선관위+마피아) 카르텔’의 실체”라며 “증거인멸 우려가 있는 만큼 즉시 특검을 실시해야 한다”고 했다.)

item.title: President Lee on Prescribing Abortion Medication: “Leaving It to Doctor’s Discretion Could Be an Option” (李대통령, 임신중지약물 처방 관련 “의사 재량에 맡기는 것도 방법”)
item.description:
President Lee on Prescribing Abortion Medication: “Leaving It to Doctor’s Discretion Could Be an Option” (李대통령, 임신중지약물 처방 관련 “의사 재량에 맡기는 것도 방법”)

On the 14th, President Lee Jae-myung said he would review allowing the use of “Mifepristone,” a medication for terminating pregnancies, adding, “Wouldn’t leaving it to the doctor’s discretion be one possible approach?” <<> During a Cabinet meeting that day, President Lee pointed out that the use of Mifepristone remains illegal due to a lack of relevant legislation, and stated, “Even if it’s a temporary patch, if it’s better than neglect, shouldn’t we at least apply that patch?” <<> The Constitutional Court ruled the abortion law unconstitutional in 2019, mandating legislative revisions by the end of the following year. However, as the National Assembly has avoided debate over whether to permit abortion and, if so, up to which week of pregnancy, the abortion law remains in a legislative vacuum. Consequently, Mifepristone, which can induce termination in early pregnancy, cannot be prescribed domestically. <<> President Lee remarked, “If we ask up to how many weeks abortion should be allowed, the whole country would erupt in controversy,” and added, “The president could push it through with full resolve, but it doesn’t seem like the kind of issue that warrants that.” <<> President Lee said, “Let’s take a more practical approach,” mentioning options such as selling it in pharmacies or allowing doctors to prescribe it at their discretion. “If selling it in pharmacies is too irresponsible,” he said, “then what about the next step—letting doctors decide at their discretion? Doctors already make judgments about human lives, don’t they?” <<> President Lee added, “We entrust doctors with decisions on life-and-death surgeries. Couldn’t we leave it to them to decide whether prescribing it is appropriate after comprehensively considering respect for life and health?” He continued, “Specifying by law exactly up to how many weeks (abortion is allowed) isn’t absolute; it could vary depending on the pregnant woman’s health condition. The law isn’t necessarily the ultimate truth.” <<> President Lee concluded, “It’s imperfect, but wouldn’t it be better than leaving it unresolved and allowing people to buy it from abroad with no prescription and no oversight? An imperfect solution is better than neglect.” The aim is to prevent problems arising from people ordering Mifepristone from overseas without a doctor’s prescription. (이재명 대통령은 14일 임신 중지 약물인 ‘미프진’ 사용을 허용하는 방안을 검토하라면서 “의사 재량으로 맡기는 것도 하나의 방법 아니겠느냐”고 말했다.)

item.title: Real Estate Supervision Task Force "58 Cases of Suspected Illegal Apartment Applications in Dongtan Uncovered… Will Track to the End" (부동산감독추진단 “동탄 아파트 부정 청약 의심 58건 적발… 끝까지 추적”)
item.description:
Real Estate Supervision Task Force "58 Cases of Suspected Illegal Apartment Applications in Dongtan Uncovered… Will Track to the End" (부동산감독추진단 “동탄 아파트 부정 청약 의심 58건 적발… 끝까지 추적”)

The government announced on the 14th that it has identified 58 individuals suspected of illegally applying for apartments in Hwaseong, Gyeonggi Province's Dongtan 2 New Town, and referred 4 of them to the prosecution. It also uncovered a case in Seoul where a person falsely sold an apartment to their own company to inflate housing prices. (정부가 경기 화성 동탄2신도시에서 아파트 청약을 부정하게 한 것으로 의심되는 사람을 58명 적발해 4명을 검찰에 송치했다고 14일 밝혔다. 서울에서 자기가 속한 회사에 아파트를 허위로 팔아 ‘집값 띄우기’를 한 사람도 적발됐다.)

On the afternoon of the same day, the Real Estate Supervision Task Force under the Office for Government Policy Coordination held a 'Real Estate Illegal Activities Response Council' with relevant agencies at the Seoul Government Complex to share the status of investigations and probes into real estate illegalities. The meeting was attended by officials from agencies involved in real estate policy, including the Ministry of Economy and Finance, the Ministry of Justice, the Ministry of the Interior and Safety, the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport, the Financial Services Commission, the Ministry of Personnel Management, the Supreme Prosecutors' Office, the National Tax Service, the National Police Agency, the Seoul Metropolitan Government, Gyeonggi Province, the Financial Supervisory Service, and the Korea Real Estate Board. <<> According to the Task Force, Gyeonggi Province identified 58 individuals suspected of illegal apartment applications in the Dongtan 2 New Town area. Their methods included falsifying residency through false address registrations to meet residence requirements, or pretending to support elderly parents to qualify for special supply offerings. Among them, 4 have been referred to the prosecution on charges of violating the Housing Act, with 3 others currently under investigation. <<> Applicant A was caught living with their family in a company dormitory in South Jeolla Province but having registered a false address in Gyeonggi Province to apply for a Dongtan apartment. Applicant B was discovered after moving their elderly mother, who lived separately in Busan, to their own address in Gyeonggi Province to falsely claim they lived together and provided care, thereby winning a special supply slot intended for those supporting elderly parents. <<> The Task Force stated that if these individuals are confirmed to have engaged in illegal applications, they will face criminal penalties of up to 3 years in prison or fines up to 30 million won, along with measures such as contract cancellation, forfeiture of down payments, and restrictions on future application eligibility. <<> The National Police Agency referred C, suspected of price manipulation, to the prosecution on charges of violating the Act on Reporting and Using of Specific Financial Transaction Information. C, an internal director of a corporation, had filed a real estate transaction report in November 2023 stating they sold an apartment in Seoul (purchased for 1.51 billion won) to the corporation for 1.65 billion won. However, the actual transfer of the apartment did not occur, and C canceled the contract with the corporation in August 2024. Subsequently, they sold the apartment to a third party for 1.8 billion won. <<> The police determined that no formal contract was signed between C and their corporation. C had received the down payment and interim payments from the corporation but returned the funds to the corporation within a few days, all while failing to report the contract's cancellation. They then sought actual buyers through a real estate agent. The police concluded that the contract between C and the corporation was a false report aimed at inflating housing prices. <<> Kim Yong-soo, Deputy Prime Minister for Economic Affairs and head of the Task Force, stated, "Illegal activities like fraudulent applications and price manipulation deprive genuine buyers of opportunities to own a home." He urged relevant agencies to "closely cooperate, conduct thorough investigations, track these cases to the end, and respond strictly in accordance with the law and principles." (국무조정실 부동산감독추진단은 이날 오후 정부서울청사에서 관계 기관들과 ‘부동산 불법행위 대응 협의회’를 열고 부동산 불법행위 조사·수사 상황을 공유했다. 회의에는 재정경제부, 법무부, 행정안전부, 국토교통부, 금융위원회, 인사혁신처, 대검찰청, 국세청, 경찰청, 서울시, 경기도, 금융감독원, 한국부동산원 등 부동산 정책 관련 기관 관계자들이 참석했다.)

item.title: Oh Se-hoon: "Just One Word on Real Estate"... Han Sung-sook: "I’ll Accept It in Writing" (오세훈 “부동산 한 말씀만”…한성숙 “서면으로 받겠다”)
item.description:
Oh Se-hoon: "Just One Word on Real Estate"... Han Sung-sook: "I’ll Accept It in Writing" (오세훈 “부동산 한 말씀만”…한성숙 “서면으로 받겠다”)

Seoul Mayor Oh Se-hoon failed to secure a speaking opportunity at the State Council meeting he attended for the first time after the June 3 local elections. (오세훈 서울시장이 6·3 지방선거 후 처음 참석한 국무회의에서 발언 기회를 얻지 못했다.)

At a State Council meeting held on the 14th to discuss pending issues such as real estate supply policies and tax reforms, Mayor Oh asked Prime Minister Han Sung-sook, "May I say a few words?" and requested to speak on real estate issues. During the meeting, relevant ministries—including the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport, the Financial Services Commission, and the Ministry of Economy and Finance—reported on seven major real estate issues, such as easing housing supply regulations and revising the comprehensive real estate tax and capital gains tax. Right after the report, Mayor Oh Se-hoon attempted to verbally present Seoul City’s policy proposals regarding urban redevelopment projects. (14일 부동산 공급 정책과 세제 개편 등의 현안을 논의하기 위해 열린 국무회의에서 오 시장은 한성숙 국무총리에게 “말씀 좀 드려도 되겠느냐”며 부동산 문제와 관련해 발언을 신청했다. 이날 국무회의에서는 국토교통부, 금융위원회, 재정경제부 등 관계 부처가 주택 공급 규제 완화와 종부세·양도세 개편 등 부동산 7대 쟁점을 보고했는데, 보고 직후 오세훈 서울시장이 도심 정비 사업에 대한 서울시의 정책 제안을 구두로 발표하려 한 것이다.)

Prime Minister Han, referencing the inter-ministerial public debate schedule set to begin on the 14th, stated, "Since there is a public debate scheduled for this matter, it would be better to refer it there for discussion," and firmly added, "Instead of an oral statement, I will accept whatever the mayor wishes to provide in written form. I will process this part as originally drafted." This was effectively a move to block Seoul City from offering verbal opinions. (한 총리는 14일부터 예정된 부처별 국민 대토론회 일정을 언급하며 “이 건은 대토론회가 있으니 그쪽으로 넘겨 논의하는 것이 좋겠다”며 “시장님이 주실 것은 구두 발언 대신 서류로 받도록 하겠다. 이 부분은 원안대로 접수하겠다”고 못 박았다. 서울시의 구두 의견 개진을 사실상 차단한 조치였다.)

Unable to secure a speaking opportunity, Mayor Oh expressed his regret. He immediately turned on his microphone and began, "Prime Minister, I have already submitted Seoul City’s prepared report earlier to the head of the policy office and the deputy prime minister," and added, "Since it seems I won’t be given a chance to speak today, I will substitute it with the content of the report." This appeared to be a pointed remark about Seoul City being sidelined during the meeting. (이에 발언 기회를 얻지 못한 오 시장은 아쉬움을 표시했다. 오 시장은 곧바로 마이크를 켜고 “총리님, 방금 전에 서울시가 준비한 보고서를 정책실장님하고 부총리님께 미리 전달해 드렸다”고 운을 뗀 뒤, “오늘 저에게 발언 기회를 안 주실 것 같으니, 보고서 내용으로 대체하겠다”고 했다. 서울시가 회의에서 패싱당하고 있는 상황을 꼬집은 것으로 보인다.)

Mayor Oh’s remarks caused the atmosphere in the meeting to turn heavy. After a brief pause to steady the mood, President Lee said, "If you are going to submit a report, please include a detailed status report on how reconstruction and redevelopment are currently proceeding in Seoul." President Lee added, "People both inside and outside the city commonly point out that Seoul’s supply volume is severely lacking. So, add to the report a detailed analysis of the specific causes and current status of why supply is being delayed and failing." In response, Mayor Oh said, "That content is already included in the report." (오 시장의 발언에 회의장 분위기는 무거워졌다. 잠시 분위기를 고른 이 대통령은 “보고서를 내실 거라면, 현재 서울시 재건축과 재개발이 어떻게 진행되고 있는지 구체적인 현황 보고도 함께 넣어달라”고 했다. 이어 이 대통령은 “시장 안팎에서 일반적으로 서울시 공급 물량이 많이 부족하다고 지적하는데, 왜 그렇게 공급이 지연되고 안 되는지에 대한 구체적인 원인과 현황 보고도 보고서에 추가해서 제출하라”고 덧붙였다. 그러자 오 시장은 “(해당 내용이) 보고서에 들어가 있다”고 했다.)

item.title: "South Korea Needs 'Risk Hedging' in Era of US-China Conflict… Should Lead Middle Power Solidarity" (“한국, 미·중 갈등 시대에 ‘위험 헤징’ 필요…중견국 연대 주도해야”)
item.description:
"South Korea Needs 'Risk Hedging' in Era of US-China Conflict… Should Lead Middle Power Solidarity" (“한국, 미·중 갈등 시대에 ‘위험 헤징’ 필요…중견국 연대 주도해야”)

"As strategic competition between the US and China intensifies, South Korea must adopt a 'cautious hedging' strategy. Fully siding with one side or containing the other is risky." (Lee Sang-hyun, former head of the Sejong Institute) (“미·중 간 전략적 경쟁이 심화되고 있는 상황에서 한국은 ‘신중한 헤징(hedging·위험 회피)’ 전략을 채택해야 합니다. 한 쪽에 완전히 가담하거나 다른 쪽을 견제하는 것은 위험합니다.(이상현 전 세종연구소장)”)

The '2026 NEAR National Strategy Round Table' discussion, hosted by the NEAR Foundation on the 14th at the Korea Chamber of Commerce and Industry in Jung-gu, Seoul, addressed the impact of recent Middle East crises, US-China tensions, and North Korea-China-Russia cooperation on international relations, as well as South Korea's responses. Participants exchanged views on the changing nature of US hegemony and how South Korea should respond. (14일 서울 중구 대한상공회의소에서 니어재단 주최로 열린 ‘2026 NEAR 국가전략 라운드 테이블’ 토론회는 최근 중동 사태와 미·중 갈등, 북·중·러 협력이 국제 관계에 미치는 영향과 한국의 대책 등을 다뤘다. 참석자들은 미국 패권의 성격 변화와 한국이 그에 어떻게 반응해야 하는지 등에 대한 의견을 나눴다)

Former director Lee Sang-hyun first stated, "There is an assessment that the US is no longer a 'benevolent hegemon' but has transformed into a 'predatory hegemon' prioritizing its own interests," adding, "The future international order is expected to be decentralized and multi-layered." He noted, "The Indo-Pacific region is rapidly emerging as the central arena for strategic competition. Strategic polarization between the US and China is becoming increasingly pronounced." (이상현 전 소장은 우선 “미국은 더 이상 ‘자비로운 패권국’이 아니라 자국 이익을 우선하는 ‘약탈적 패권국’으로 변화했다는 평가가 나온다”며 “향후 국제 질서는 탈중심적, 다층적으로 흘러갈 것으로 예상된다“고 했다. 그러면서 “인도·태평양 지역은 전략 경쟁의 중심 공간으로 급격히 부상하고 있다. 미국과 중국 간 전략적 양극화가 점차 뚜렷해지는 추세”라고 했다.)

In this environment, Lee argued that "Asian countries have increasingly shown a tendency to pursue multi-layered hedging strategies rather than choosing between the US and China," asserting that South Korea should also pursue "cautious hedging." Hedging refers to a strategy where, amid great power competition, a specific country cooperates with both sides simultaneously to spread risk. (이 전 소장은 이런 환경에서 “아시아 국가들은 미국과 중국 중 하나를 선택하기보다 다층적 헤징 전략을 추구하는 성향이 증대했다”고 했다. 한국도 ‘신중한 헤징’을 추구해야 한다고 주장했다. 헤징이란 강대국 간 경쟁 상황에서 특정국이 양측과 동시에 협력하며 위험을 분산시키는 전략이다.)

Lee then proposed specific hedging strategies: ▲self-strengthening ▲solidarity ▲inclusiveness. Self-strengthening means enhancing national capabilities such as military and technological power; solidarity means strengthening ties with countries sharing common values; and inclusiveness means expanding the scope of South Korean diplomacy to include China, Russia, and the Global South (developing countries in the Southern Hemisphere). He suggested this could allow South Korea to lead "middle power solidarity." (이 전 소장은 그러면서 ▲자강 ▲연대 ▲포용이라는 구체적 헤징 전략을 제시했다. 자강은 군사·기술력 등 국가의 역량을 키우는 것, 연대는 가치관을 공유하는 국가들과 유대를 강화하는 것, 포용은 중국·러시아와 글로벌 사우스(남반구 개발도상국) 등으로 한국 외교의 범위를 확대하는 것을 뜻한다. 이를 통해 한국이 ‘중견국 연대’를 주도할 수 있다고 했다.)

Panelist Lee Shin-hwa, a professor at Korea University, stated, "South Korea's grand strategy should be to become a 'strategic connector' rather than a 'follower,' linking the ROK-US Alliance, ROK-US-Japan cooperation, NATO, IP4 (Indo-Pacific 4 Partners), G7 Plus, and the Global South together." He added, "If we emphasize only democratic cooperation while ignoring the demands of the Global South, it may appear as a Western-centric club." (토론자로 나선 이신화 고려대 교수는 “한국의 대전략은 ‘추종자’가 아니라 ‘전략적 연결자’가 되는 것”이라며 “한미동맹과 한미일 협력, NATO(북대서양조약기구)와 IP4(인도·태평양 4국 파트너), G7 플러스, 글로벌 사우스 등을 서로 연결해야 한다”고 말했다. 그러면서 “글로벌 사우스의 요구를 무시한 채 민주주의 협력만 강조하면, 서방 중심 클럽으로 보일 수 있다”고 했다.)

There were also calls to strengthen solidarity with the US and Gulf nations. Jang Ji-hyang, senior research fellow at the Asan Institute for Policy Studies, said regarding Middle East dynamics, "The UAE, a key security partner for South Korea, was intensively targeted by Iranian missile attacks, but South Korea failed to actively express solidarity. We need to participate more actively in the US and NATO-led CRINK (China, Russia, Iran, North Korea) response." (미국 및 걸프 국가들과의 연대를 강화하자는 목소리도 나왔다. 장지향 아산정책연구원 수석연구위원은 중동 정세와 관련해 “아랍에미리트(UAE)는 한국의 핵심 안보 협력국으로 이란 미사일 공격을 집중적으로 받았지만, 한국은 연대 의사를 적극적으로 제시하지 못했다”며 “미국과 NATO가 추진하는 CRINK(중국·러시아·이란·북한) 대응에 보다 적극 참여할 필요가 있다”고 했다.)

Senior Research Fellow Jang also noted that when South Korea's 'NaMuHo' was hit by an Iranian-origin missile in the Strait of Hormuz, the diplomatic authorities' condemnation message was ambiguous. He said, "It's true that we showed a response that seemed like a condemnation but wasn't quite one, which the Gulf countries found very strange." Immediately after the attack, Iran denied targeting the NaMuHo, and while South Korean diplomatic authorities stated that "the possibility of an entity other than Iran attacking the NaMuHo is low," they did not issue a clear condemnation message. Only about 20 days later did they release related investigation results and summon Iranian Ambassador to South Korea Saeed Koozechi to the foreign ministry building to protest. (장 수석연구위원은 한국의 ‘나무호’가 호르무즈 해협에서 이란산 미사일에 피격됐을 때 우리 외교 당국의 규탄 메시지가 불분명했다고도 말했다. 그는 “우리는 (당시) 규탄인데 규탄이 아닌 듯한 모습을 보여줘서 걸프 국가 쪽에서 굉장히 이상하게 생각했던 것은 사실”이라고 했다. 피격 직후 이란 측은 나무호 공격을 부인했고, 우리 외교 당국은 “이란 이외 주체가 나무호를 공격했을 가능성은 낮다”면서도 뚜렷한 규탄 메시지를 내진 않았다. 이후 20여 일이 지난 뒤에야 관련 조사 결과를 발표하고 사이드 쿠제치 주한 이란 대사를 외교부 청사로 초치하며 항의했다.)

Regarding the US emphasizing the 'strategic flexibility' of US Forces Korea (USFK), suggestions were made to use South Korea's desired outcomes as 'bargaining chips.' Ha Kyung-seok, associate research fellow at the Institute for National Security Strategy, said, "While granting a certain degree of strategic flexibility to USFK, how much strategic autonomy can South Korea secure in return? Particularly, various cards such as nuclear fuel cycle capabilities, our nuclear potential, and the introduction of nuclear-powered submarines should be bundled together for negotiation." (미국이 주한미군의 ‘전략적 유연성’을 강조하는 것에 대해, 한국이 그 대가로 원하는 내용을 ‘협상 카드’로 제시하는 방법이 검토돼야 한다는 제언도 나왔다. 하경석 국가안보전략연구원 부연구위원은 “주한미군의 전략적 유연성을 어느 정도 확보해 주면서, 한국이 가질 수 있는 전략적 자율성을 얼마나 가져올 수 있을 것인가”라며 “특히 핵 연료 주기 능력이나 우리 핵 잠재력, 원자력 추진 잠수함의 도입 등 여러 가지 카드를 하나로 묶어서 타협이 되어야 한다”고 말했다.)

Jeong Duck-koo, chairman of the NEAR Foundation, stated, "Beyond bilateral relations between Korea-US or Korea-China, it is crucial how we solve the triangular relationship equation among Korea, the US, and China. We must pursue both value balance and interest balance." <<>> (정덕구 니어재단 이사장은 “한·미나 한·중의 양자 관계를 넘어서 이제는 한·미·중 3각 매트릭스의 관계 방정식을 어떻게 풀어나가느냐가 중요하다”며 “가치적 균형과 이익의 균형을 함께 추구해야 한다”고 말했다.)

item.title: "To Strengthen the Burden of Owning Ultra-High-Priced Homes, Press 1" – Lee Conducts an Instant Comment Poll (“초고가 주택 보유부담 강화는 1번 눌러보세요” 李, 즉석 댓글 조사)
item.description:
"To Strengthen the Burden of Owning Ultra-High-Priced Homes, Press 1" – Lee Conducts an Instant Comment Poll (“초고가 주택 보유부담 강화는 1번 눌러보세요” 李, 즉석 댓글 조사)

President Lee Jae-myung on the 14th asked for opinions in real-time through YouTube comments on whether to increase the burden on owning a single, ultra-high-priced home for actual residence. The majority of comment participants agreed with the opinion that "even for a single ultra-high-priced home used for actual residence, there should be a greater burden," and President Lee remarked, "It seems most people agree." (이재명 대통령이 14일 초고가 실거주 1주택 보유 부담 강화에 대한 의견을 유튜브 댓글을 통해 실시간으로 물었다. 댓글 참여자 대다수가 “초고가 주택은 실거주 1주택이라도 더 부담해야 한다”는 의견에 찬성했고, 이 대통령은 “대체로 동감하는 거 같다”고 말했다.)

After receiving a report on the 'Plan to Gather Public Opinions on Real Estate Policies' during a Cabinet meeting presided over at the Blue House that day, President Lee said, "There is controversy over whether it's right to impose the same burden on so-called 'prime single homes'—ultra-high-priced properties worth over 10 billion won—just because they are single homes for actual residence," adding, "I'll have viewers watching this broadcast press number 1 or number 2." (이 대통령은 이날 청와대에서 주재한 국무회의에서 ‘부동산정책 관련 국민 의견 수렴계획’ 보고를 받은 뒤 “소위 ‘똘똘한 한 채’라고 100억원 이상 초고가 집에 대해 실거주 1주택이라고 해서 똑같이 부담을 지우는 것이 맞느냐는 데에는 논란이 있다”며 “방송 보시는 국민 여러분들 중에 1번과 2번 누르기를 해보겠다”고 했다.)

He then proposed, "If you think it's better to impose a differentiated, greater burden on ultra-high-priced single homes for actual residence, please press 1. If not, press 2." In response, the number 1 appeared repeatedly in the comments of the live Cabinet meeting YouTube video. Director of the Office for Government Policy Coordination, Im Ki-geun, reported, "Most comments are number 1. About 90% are number 1." (그러면서 “실거주 1주택인데 초고가에 대해서는 차별적으로 더 많은 부담을 시키는 게 좋겠다고 생각하면 1번을, 그게 아니라고 생각하면 2번을 눌러달라”고 제안했다. 그러자 국무회의 실시간 유튜브 영상 댓글엔 숫자 1이 연달아 올라왔고, 임기근 국무조정실장이 “대부분의 댓글이 1번이다. 90%가량이 1번”이라고 보고했다.)

President Lee responded, "It seems there is general agreement on strengthening the burden on ultra-high-priced homes, even if they are single homes for actual residence," and said, "I'm letting you know in advance that we will proceed in this manner in the future." He indicated that at an upcoming real estate policy debate, such methods would be used to discuss key issues in real estate policy. (이에 이 대통령은 “실거주 1주택이라도 초고가 주택에는 부담을 더 강화하자는 데에 대체로 공감하는 것 같다”며 “이제 나중에 이런 식으로 진행을 할 거다라고 미리 말씀을 드린다”고 했다. 곧 있을 부동산 정책 토론회에서 이런 식으로 부동산 정책 쟁점에 대해 토론해보겠다는 것이다.)

An instant poll on the threshold for ultra-high-priced homes followed. President Lee asked viewers to press 1 for 1 billion won or more, 2 for 2 billion won or more, and 3 for 3 billion won or more. When Director Im said, "Many people wrote based on the 3 billion won threshold," President Lee laughed and commented, "Isn't that too harsh? If the market price is 3 billion won, the publicly assessed value would only be around 1 billion something won." When Policy Planning Director Kim Yong-beom noted, "Many also answered with 2 billion won," President Lee said, "If we go with 2 billion won, we might be in big trouble." (초고가 주택 기준에 대한 즉석 조사도 이어졌다. 이 대통령은 10억원 이상이면 1번, 20억원 이상이면 2번, 30억원 이상이면 3번을 눌러달라고 했다. 임 실장이 “30억원을 기준으로 써 준 분들이 많다”고 하자, 이 대통령은 웃으며 “너무 가혹한 것이 아닌가. 시가 기준으로 30억원이면 공시지가로는 10몇억원밖에 안 되는 것이 아닌가”라고 했다. 김용범 정책실장이 “20억원으로 답한 사람들도 많다”고 하자 이 대통령은 “20억원으로 하면 우리 큰일 날 것 같다”고 했다.)

Regarding discussions on reforming real estate taxation, President Lee stated, "The tax system is currently highly distorted. As a result, it has become a factor inducing real estate speculation," and added, "Normalizing this is the primary goal." (이 대통령은 부동산 세제 개편 논의에 대해 “조세 제도가 지금 많이 왜곡돼 있다. 그러다 보니 부동산 투기 유발 요인이 돼 버린 것”이라며 “이를 정상화하는 게 1차 목표”라고 했다.)

item.title: “Can’t Even Track Those Who Gave Up Voting”… Opposition Says “Election Mafia Cartel Exposed” (與 “투표포기 인원도 파악못해”…野 “선피아 카르텔 드러나”)
item.description:
“Can’t Even Track Those Who Gave Up Voting”… Opposition Says “Election Mafia Cartel Exposed” (與 “투표포기 인원도 파악못해”…野 “선피아 카르텔 드러나”)

The National Assembly’s special committee for the parliamentary investigation into the ballot shortage crisis during the June 3 local elections criticized the National Election Commission’s (NEC) inadequate response at its first hearing held at the parliament on the 14th. (국회 6·3 지방선거 투표용지 부족 사태 국정조사특위는 14일 국회에서 열린 1차 청문회에서 선관위의 부실 대응을 질타했다.)

Rep. Yoon Geon-young of the Democratic Party, who serves as the ruling party’s secretary, said on the day, “The essence of this crisis is that they couldn’t even figure out how many people gave up voting,” and added, “Do you acknowledge the responsibility for failing to properly account for residents of large apartment complexes, based on the projected number of voters from the end of last year?” He further pointed out that during the height of the confusion, employees of the Songpa District Election Commission were dining outside the office using business expense funds, and criticized that “Reports were not properly made, causing the situation management system to collapse.” <<> Rep. Yang Bu-nam of the Democratic Party also said, “After a war ends, don’t you first determine the number of deaths? Yet it seems the NEC doesn’t even have accurate statistics on how many voters had their right to vote infringed upon.” He added, “The NEC says 22 people couldn’t vote, but arithmetically, it comes out to 43.” <<> Rep. Joo Jin-woo of the People Power Party mentioned that contracts worth over 17.5 billion won were funneled to companies linked to former NEC executives and their families, saying, “The reality of the ‘Election Mafia (NEC + Mafia) cartel’ has been exposed.” Rep. Shin Dong-uk of the same party also asked, “Can the NEC possibly not know that a person who retired in 2003 set up multiple companies and swept up NEC supplies?” He continued, “Even without a full investigation, do you have plans to conduct a preemptive and comprehensive review?” In response, Acting NEC Chairman Wi Cheol-hwan said, “If such a cartel exists, I believe it must be thoroughly eradicated,” and added, “I will try to do as you, Rep. Shin, have instructed.” <<> The NEC stated that it could allow a public recount of the so-called “twin vote” results if the National Assembly passes a resolution to that effect. When Special Committee Chairman Rep. Yoon Sang-hyun of the People Power Party asked, “What do you think about agreeing to a public recount for Songdo Districts 1 and 2?” Acting Secretary-General Kang Dong-wan said, “If it’s a verification process under the Act on Testimony and Appraisal before the National Assembly, and if the special committee passes a resolution, we can do it,” indicating a willingness to comply if the ruling and opposition party secretaries on the committee reach an agreement. <<> The issue of state compensation for voters who received a waiting number but ultimately could not vote was also discussed. Rep. Yoon Sang-hyun mentioned cases at polling station 2 in Jamsil 7-dong, Songpa District, where people got waiting numbers but couldn’t vote, and said, “Shouldn’t the NEC apologize for causing people to give up voting and even proactively provide state compensation?” Acting Chairman Wi replied, “I also felt quite uneasy after learning about that part, and I am continuously trying to get more details.” <<> Additionally, suspicions were raised that the NEC may have effectively directed the Seoul Metropolitan Election Commission by sending reference materials before the latter’s review of an election petition. Acting Chairman Wi explained, “It was at the working-level officials’ level sharing relevant documents, and I don’t see it as an official review opinion. Local election commission reviews must always be conducted independently.” He added, “If that was inappropriate, I apologize.” (여당 간사인 민주당 윤건영 의원은 이날 “투표를 포기한 인원조차 파악하지 못한 게 이번 사태의 본질”이라며 “지난해 말 예상 선거인 수를 기준으로 삼아 대규모 아파트 입주자들을 제대로 파악하지 못한 책임을 인정하느냐”고 했다. 이어 혼란이 극심했던 시간대에 송파구선관위 직원들이 청사 밖에서 업무 추진비로 식사를 하고 있었다고 지적하면서 “보고도 제대로 이뤄지지 않아 상황 관리 체계가 무너졌다”고 비판했다.)

item.title: [Exclusive] Police Officer Awarded for Victim Protection, but Concealed Evidence in Jang Yun-ki Case ([단독]피해자 보호 표창 받은 경찰, 정작 장윤기 증거는 덮었다)
item.description:
[Exclusive] Police Officer Awarded for Victim Protection, but Concealed Evidence in Jang Yun-ki Case ([단독]피해자 보호 표창 받은 경찰, 정작 장윤기 증거는 덮었다)

It was confirmed on the 14th that Superintendent Park (59), head of the investigation team at Gwangsan Police Station, who was arrested on charges including destroying key evidence in the "Gwangju, Jeonnam High School Girl Murder Case," received a ministerial commendation for "crime victim protection." Superintendent Park is accused of leaking investigative information to the father of suspect Jang Yun-ki (23, detained), who is also a current police officer, Superintendent Jang (55), and of destroying key evidence. (‘전남광주 여고생 피살 사건’의 핵심 증거를 인멸한 혐의 등으로 구속된 광산경찰서 수사팀장 박모(59) 경감이 ‘범죄 피해자 보호’ 명목으로 장관 표창을 받은 것으로 14일 확인됐다. 박 경감은 피의자 장윤기(23·구속)의 부친이자 현직 경찰인 장모(55) 경감에게 수사 정보를 넘기고, 핵심 증거 또한 인멸한 혐의를 받고 있다.)

According to commendation records submitted by the Gwangju Provincial Police to the office of Representative Shin Dong-wook of the People Power Party, Superintendent Park received a commendation from the Minister of the Interior and Safety in October 2022, marking the 77th Police Day. The reason for the commendation was "his outstanding service in crime victim protection activities with a strong sense of duty." (광주경찰청이 국민의힘 신동욱 의원실에 제출한 상훈 내역에 따르면, 박 경감은 2022년 10월 제77주년 경찰의 날을 맞아 행정안전부 장관 표창을 받았다. ‘투철한 사명감으로 범죄 피해자 보호 활동에 공이 지대하다’는 것이 표창 사유였다.)

The commendation record shows that Superintendent Park took charge of and closely managed 128 crime victims. A representative achievement recorded was providing smartwatches to 74 victims who felt threatened. Additionally, he arranged psychological counseling and supported medical expenses for crime victims. He also took measures to ensure that the bereaved families of victims killed in violent crimes could receive funeral expenses and tuition support. (공적 조서를 보면 박 경감은 범죄 피해자 128명을 접수해 밀착 관리했다. 신변에 위협을 느끼는 피해자 74명에게 스마트워치를 지급한 것이 대표적인 성과로 기재되어 있다. 이밖에 범죄 피해자들의 심리상담 주선, 의료비 지원에 나서기도 했다. 또 강력 범죄로 사망한 피해자 유가족이 장례비·학자금까지 받을 수 있도록 조치했다.)

Superintendent Park, who joined the police force in 1996, had received a total of 43 commendations until last year. In 2008, he received an "Exemplary Public Official" commendation from the Prime Minister, and in 2023, the criminal investigation team he led was selected as the "Top Criminal Investigation Team of Gwangju Provincial Police." Despite this, Superintendent Park was arrested on charges of evidence tampering in the investigation of a crime committed by Jang Yun-ki, the child of a fellow police officer. (1996년 경찰에 입직한 박 경감은 지난해까지 도합 43차례 상훈을 받은 것으로 나타났다. 2008년 국무총리로부터 ‘모범 공무원’ 표창을 받았고, 2023년에는 박 경감이 이끄는 형사팀이 ‘광주청 으뜸 형사팀’으로 선정되기도 했다. 그랬던 박 경감이 동료 경찰관의 자녀인 장윤기가 저지른 범죄 수사에서는 증거인멸 혐의로 구속된 것이다.)

Prosecutors are expanding their investigation based on the belief that Superintendent Park concealed a 50cm-long industrial cable tie that had been prepared to bind the victim in Jang Yun-ki's vehicle. According to the prosecution's investigation, on May 5, when the high school girl was murdered, the investigation team led by Superintendent Park discovered the cable tie in Jang Yun-ki's SUV. (검찰은 박 경감이 장윤기 차량에서 피해자를 결박하려 준비한 50㎝ 길이의 공업용 케이블 타이를 숨긴 것으로 보고 수사를 확대하고 있다. 검찰 조사 결과, 여고생이 살해된 지난 5월 5일 박 경감이 이끄는 수사팀은 피의자 장윤기의 SUV 차량에서 케이블 타이를 발견했다.)

Although this remains in the forensic analysis report of the police scientific investigation unit, Superintendent Park is reported to have instructed team members, "Leave the cable tie as it is." The next day, May 6, Superintendent Park handed over the crime vehicle to Superintendent Jang, a current police officer and Jang Yun-ki's father. Superintendent Jang removed the cable tie from the vehicle and hid it at his home. (이는 경찰 과학수사대의 감식 보고서에 남아있지만, 박 경감은 수사팀원들에게 “케이블 타이를 그대로 놔두라”고 지시한 것으로 전해졌다. 이튿날인 5월 6일 박 경감은 범행 차량을 현직 경찰이자 장윤기 부친인 장 경감에게 넘겼다. 장 경감은 차량에서 케이블 타이를 빼내서 자택에 숨겼다.)

The cable tie is considered key evidence to prove the charge of rape-murder. While a prison term is possible for simple murder, the statutory penalty for rape-murder is death or life imprisonment. Initially, police charged Jang Yun-ki with simple murder and sent the case to the prosecution, but after supplementary investigation, the prosecution changed the charge to rape-murder and indicted him. (케이블 타이는 강간 살인 혐의를 입증할 핵심 증거로 꼽힌다. 단순 살인은 유기징역형 선고가 가능하지만, 강간 등 살인은 법정형이 사형 또는 무기징역이다. 당초 경찰은 장윤기에게 단순 살인 혐의를 적용해 검찰에 송치했지만, 검찰은 보완 수사 결과 강간 등 상인 혐의로 변경해서 구속 기소했다.)

Superintendent Park, the investigation team leader, also provided investigative information to Superintendent Jang, the father of Jang Yun-ki, through dozens of phone calls. Around May 7, the investigation team shared the password to Jang Yun-ki's studio apartment with Superintendent Jang. Subsequently, on May 8, Superintendent Jang took sick leave, entered his son Jang Yun-ki's studio, cut up two sex dolls (adult dolls), which were key evidence of the rape-murder, and scattered and disposed of the pieces in various locations across Gwangju and Jeonnam. (수사팀장 박 경감은 장윤기 부친인 장 경감과 수십 차례 통화하며 수사 정보를 알려주기도 했다. 수사팀은 5월 7일 전후로 장 경감에게 장윤기의 원룸 비밀번호를 공유했다. 이후 5월 8일 장 경감은 병가를 내고 아들인 장윤기 원룸에 들어가 강간살인의 핵심 증거인 리얼돌(성인용 인형) 2점을 토막 내 광주·전남 곳곳에 분산 폐기했다.)

On the same day, during a phone call with Superintendent Park, the investigation team leader, Superintendent Jang is reported to have asked, "Is it under the Yeongsan River Advanced Bridge where Jang Yun-ki threw away the cell phone he usually used?" When Superintendent Park confirmed, "That's right," Superintendent Jang personally searched the area around the Advanced Bridge. The cell phone that Jang Yun-ki discarded has not been found to date. (같은 날 장 경감은 수사팀장인 박 경감과 통화에서 “장윤기가 평소 쓰던 휴대전화를 버린 곳이 영산강 첨단대교 밑이냐”고 묻기도 한 것으로 전해졌다. 박 경감이 “맞다”고 확인하자 장 경감은 첨단대교 주변을 직접 수색했고, 장윤기가 버린 휴대전화는 현재까지 발견되지 않고 있다.)

As these circumstances of crime concealment and cover-up were revealed through the prosecution's supplementary investigation, the bereaved family of the victim in the "Jang Yun-ki Case" stated at a press conference on the 8th, "The police, whom we believed would clear our daughter's grievances, were not on our side but on the side of the murderer," adding, "How dare those who can't even follow the basic procedures for securing evidence impersonate police officers?" (이 같은 범죄 은폐·축소 정황이 검찰 보완수사로 드러나자 ‘장윤기 사건’ 피해자 유가족은 지난 8일 기자회견에서 “우리 딸의 억울함을 풀어줄 것이라고 믿었던 경찰이 우리 편이 아니라 살인마의 편이었다”며 “증거를 확보해야 하는 기본적인 사항도 지키지 않는 자들이 감히 경찰을 사칭하느냐”고 했다.)

They further stated, "The truth was distorted because the perpetrator's father is a police officer," and "Thinking about the reality that public authority conspired with the criminal to mutilate the truth, my whole body still trembles." (그러면서 “가해자의 아버지가 경찰이라는 이유로 진실이 왜곡됐다”면서 “공권력이 (범죄자와) 한패가 되어 진실을 난도질하려 했던 현실을 생각하면 지금도 온몸이 떨린다”고 했다.)

It has also been confirmed that Superintendent Jang, the father who destroyed key evidence in Jang Yun-ki's rape-murder case, had received 34 commendations since joining the police in 2000 until last year. (장윤기 강간살인의 핵심 증거를 인멸했던 부친 장 경감 또한 2000년 경찰에 입직한 이후 지난해까지 34차례의 상훈을 받은 것으로 파악됐다.)

Representative Shin Dong-wook of the People Power Party stated, "The 'Jang Yun-ki Case' symbolically demonstrates how dangerous the complete abolition of the prosecution's supplementary investigation power, which the Democratic Party of Korea is unilaterally pushing for, is," and "The commendations for the two police officers who concealed the crime of a 'police family member' should all be revoked, and they must be severely punished." (국민의힘 신동욱 의원은 “‘장윤기 사건’은 더불어민주당이 일방적으로 밀어붙이는 검찰 보완 수사권 완전 폐지가 얼마나 위험한 것인지 상징적으로 보여주고 있다”며 “‘경찰 식구’의 범죄를 은폐한 두 경찰의 상훈은 모두 박탈하고, 엄중하게 처벌해야 할 것”이라고 말했다.)

item.title: [Exclusive] Ruling Party Leadership at General Meeting: "Complete Abolition of Supplementary Investigation Powers Never Adopted as Party Policy" ([단독] 與 원내지도부, 의총서 “보완수사권 폐지, 당론 채택한 적 없다”)
item.description:
[Exclusive] Ruling Party Leadership at General Meeting: "Complete Abolition of Supplementary Investigation Powers Never Adopted as Party Policy" ([단독] 與 원내지도부, 의총서 “보완수사권 폐지, 당론 채택한 적 없다”)

Amid internal disagreements within the Democratic Party over its push for the 'complete abolition of prosecutors' supplementary investigation powers,' the party leadership reportedly explained at a general meeting of lawmakers on the 14th that "the complete abolition of supplementary investigation powers has never been adopted as party policy." (더불어민주당이 추진 중인 ‘검사 보완수사권 전면 폐지’를 두고 당내에서 이견이 분출한 가운데, 원내지도부가 14일 의원총회에서 “보완수사권 전면 폐지는 당론으로 채택된 적이 없다”는 취지로 설명한 것으로 알려졌다.)

At the general meeting, the Democratic Party discussed the amendment drafted by the task force (TF) on revising the Criminal Procedure Act. Chief Policy Coordinator Kim Han-kyu explained the TF's proposal, which centers on completely abolishing supplementary investigation powers, before hearing lawmakers' opinions. (민주당은 이날 의원총회에서 형사소송법 개정 태스크포스(TF)가 마련한 개정안을 논의했다. 김한규 원내정책수석이 보완수사권 전면 폐지를 골자로 한 TF 안을 설명한 뒤 의원들의 의견을 들었다.)

During this process, nine lawmakers, including Park Kyun-taek, Lee So-young, Hong Ki-won, and Go Min-jung, reportedly expressed opposition to the complete abolition of supplementary investigation powers. Separately, opinions were also raised emphasizing the need to maintain a cooperative system between prosecutors and police. It was reported that proposals included maintaining a structure of mutual checks between the prosecution and police while allowing prosecutors to review records during the police investigation phase. (이 과정에서 박균택·이소영·홍기원·고민정 의원 등 9명은 보완수사권 전면 폐지에 반대 의견을 낸 것으로 전해졌다. 이와 별도로 검·경 협력 체계를 유지해야 한다는 취지의 의견도 제기됐다. 검찰과 경찰이 상호 견제하는 구조를 유지하면서 경찰 수사 단계에서 검사가 기록을 열람할 수 있도록 하는 방안 등을 제시한 것으로 알려졌다.)

Additionally, a lawmaker who opposed the complete abolition of supplementary investigation powers at the meeting reportedly demanded, "Was the abolition of supplementary investigation powers truly adopted as party policy in February? Please reconfirm." The leadership responded, "Upon checking, it was not confirmed as party policy." While the Democratic Party had been pushing for the complete abolition of supplementary investigation powers as de facto party policy as part of prosecutorial reform, the leadership denied this at the meeting. (또 이날 보완수사권 전면폐지에 반대한 한 의원은 의총에서 “보완수사권 폐지가 지난 2월 당론으로 채택된 것이 맞느냐. 다시 확인해 달라”고 요구했고, 원내지도부는 “확인해 보니 당론으로 추인된 것은 아니다”라고 답한 것으로 전해졌다. 그동안 민주당은 검찰개혁의 일환으로 보완수사권 전면 폐지를 사실상 당론처럼 추진해 왔지만, 원내지도부가 이날 이를 부인한 것이다.)

One lawmaker who attended the meeting said, "The atmosphere at the time was that someone was pushing strongly, so it wasn't easy for anyone to voice opposition. However, I understand it was not a matter that received confirmation from lawmakers." (의총에 참석한 한 의원은 “(당시 의총에서) 누군가 강하게 주장하는 분위기여서 아무도 반대 의견을 내기 쉽지 않았던 것 아니겠느냐”라며 “그렇다고 의원들의 추인을 받은 사안은 아니었던 것으로 안다”고 말했다.)

Separately, a Democratic Party lawmaker with a legal background announced plans to propose a separate amendment to the Criminal Procedure Act that would partially retain supplementary investigation powers. The lawmaker argued, "In the digital age, electronic data can be deleted or damaged in a short time, so a certain scope of supplementary investigation powers is necessary." (이날 법조인 출신의 한 민주당 의원은 보완수사권을 일부 유지하는 내용의 별도 형사소송법 개정안 발의를 예고하기도 했다. 해당 의원은 “디지털 시대에는 전자자료 등이 짧은 시간 안에 삭제되거나 훼손될 수 있어 일정 범위의 보완수사권은 필요하다”고 주장했다.)

It was reported that the key proposal involves requiring prosecutors to draft and register decisions on supplementary investigations, with a supplementary investigation review officer conducting post-inspection to control arbitrary supplementary investigations by prosecutors. (또 검사가 보완수사 결정문을 작성·등록하고, 보완수사심의관이 이를 사후 점검하도록 해 검사의 자의적 보완수사를 통제하는 방안이 핵심인 것으로 전해졌다.)

Although party leadership candidates, including former Prime Minister Kim Min-seok, former leader Jeong Cheong-rae, and lawmaker Song Young-gil, attended the general meeting, they did not make public statements. The previous day, former leader Jeong appeared on Kim Eo-joon's YouTube channel "News Factory," emphasizing, "The complete abolition of supplementary investigation powers is the Democratic Party's position and party policy," calling it a "basic principle." (이날 의원총회에는 당권 주자인 김민석 전 국무총리와 정청래 전 대표, 송영길 의원도 참석했지만 공개 발언은 하지 않았다. 전날 정 전 대표는 김어준 씨의 유튜브 방송 ‘뉴스공장’에 출연해 “보완수사권 전면 폐지는 민주당의 입장이고 당론”이라며 “기본 원칙”이라고 거듭 강조했었다.)

The Democratic Party did not reach a final conclusion on supplementary investigation powers at the meeting. Floor spokesperson Lee Ju-hee told reporters after the meeting, "We have entered a full deliberation process on the Criminal Procedure Act amendment," adding, "It's a process of refining the bill to address potential side effects from prosecutorial reform and ensure citizens are protected within the judicial system." (민주당은 이날 보완수사권 관련해 최종 결론을 내리지 않았다. 이주희 원내대변인은 의총 후 기자들과 만나 “형사소송법 개정안에 대한 본격적인 숙의 과정에 들어갔다”며 “검찰개혁 과정에서 발생할 수 있는 부작용을 보완하고 국민이 사법 시스템 안에서 보호받을 수 있도록 법안의 완성도를 높여가는 과정”이라고 말했다.)

She added, "Today's meeting heard a wide range of opinions, and we are preparing a policy meeting with experts around next week." (이어 “오늘 의총에서도 다양한 의견을 충분히 들었고, 다음 주쯤 전문가 정책의원총회도 준비하고 있다”고 했다.)

item.title: President Lee Says “I No Longer Have a Home”... Bundang Apartment Sold (李대통령 “난 이제 집 없다”... 분당아파트 팔렸다)
item.description:
President Lee Says “I No Longer Have a Home”... Bundang Apartment Sold (李대통령 “난 이제 집 없다”... 분당아파트 팔렸다)

It was reported on the 14th that the sale of President Lee Jae-myung’s apartment in Bundang-gu, Seongnam-si, Gyeonggi Province, has been nearly completed. A Cheong Wa Dae official stated, “I understand that the final contract will be signed within a few days.” (이재명 대통령이 소유한 경기 성남시 분당구 아파트의 매각 작업이 거의 마무리된 것으로 14일 전해졌다. 청와대 관계자는 “수일 내에 본계약이 이뤄지는 것으로 안다”고 했다.)

President Lee put the Bundang-gu apartment on the market last March. At the time, he announced regulations on non-resident single homeowners, saying, “We will mobilize all policy tools to create a situation where selling is more advantageous than holding onto a single home that is not for residence but for investment or speculation.” In response to criticism from the opposition party, which questioned, “Isn’t the president also a non-resident single homeowner?” President Lee put his own apartment up for sale. (이 대통령은 지난 3월 분당구 아파트를 매물로 내놨다. 이 대통령은 당시 “정책 수단을 총동원해 주거용이 아닌 투자·투기용 1주택자도 보유보다 매각이 유리한 상황을 만들 것”이라며 비거주 1주택자에 대한 규제를 예고했다. 이에 대해 야당 등에서 ‘대통령도 비거주 1주택자 아니냐’는 식의 비판이 나오자 이 대통령 본인 소유의 아파트를 내놓았다.)

Although it was listed for sale, it took over four months to actually finalize the contract. A Cheong Wa Dae official explained, “Bundang-gu is designated as a land transaction permit zone, so the buyer must actually reside in the property, but since the president’s home currently has a tenant, we needed to coordinate the timing.” (매물로 내놓긴 했지만 실제 계약까지는 4개월이 넘게 걸렸다. 청와대 관계자는 “분당구는 토지 거래 허가 구역으로 지정된 곳이어서 집을 산 사람이 실거주를 해야 하는데 현재 대통령의 집에는 세입자도 있어 시기를 조율해야 했다”고 했다.)

President Lee has owned this apartment, with an exclusive area of 164㎡, since 1998. The recent market price of this apartment has exceeded 3 billion won. President Lee listed it for 2.9 billion won, but the actual contract price has not been confirmed. (이 대통령은 전용 164㎡ 면적의 이 아파트를 1998년부터 소유했다. 최근 이 아파트 실거래가는 30억원을 넘어섰다. 이 대통령은 이 아파트를 29억원에 내놨었는데, 실제 계약 가격이 얼마인지는 확인되지 않았다.)

Meanwhile, during a Cabinet meeting that day, President Lee asked Prime Minister Han Sung-sook, “Is your home worth over 2 billion won?” adding, “I no longer have a home.” This conversation arose during a discussion on setting the threshold for strengthening tax burdens on ultra-high-priced homes. Prime Minister Han replied, “I have one home worth over 2 billion won.” (한편 이 대통령은 이날 국무회의에서 한성숙 국무총리를 향해 “(집이) 20억이 넘느냐”며 “나는 이제 집이 없다”고 말하기도 했다. 초고가 주택에 대한 조세 부담 강화를 할 경우, 기준을 얼마로 할지 논의하던 중 나온 대화다. 한 총리는 “집이 한 채 있는데 20억이 넘는다”고 답했다.)

item.title: [Exclusive] National Assembly Questions NEC Staff Receiving Incentive Pay for Election Management: "Isn't That Their Main Job?" ([단독] 선거 관리했다고 격려금 받는 선관위… 국회 “그게 본업인데 왜 받나”)
item.description:
[Exclusive] National Assembly Questions NEC Staff Receiving Incentive Pay for Election Management: "Isn't That Their Main Job?" ([단독] 선거 관리했다고 격려금 받는 선관위… 국회 “그게 본업인데 왜 받나”)

The National Assembly has pointed out that it is inappropriate for National Election Commission (NEC) employees to receive hundreds of thousands of won every election, a practice that has been ongoing. (선거관리위원회 직원들이 선거 때마다 수십만 원을 챙겨 온 관행에 대해 국회가 부적절하다고 지적했다.)

According to the 2025 fiscal year settlement analysis report released by the National Assembly Budget Office (NABO) on the 10th, the NEC has been paying incentives called "special commendation allowances" to its own public officials and dispatched or commissioned public officials during each election. During last year's presidential election, NEC Grade 5 public officials received 150,000 won per month for four months from April to July, totaling 600,000 won, while those below Grade 6 received 100,000 won per month, totaling 400,000 won. A total of 2,628 people received 1.114 billion won. <<> The special commendation allowance system exists only within the NEC among state agencies. It was established in 1992 with the addition of a clause to the NEC Act stating, "During the period of various elections and national referendums, special commendation allowances may be paid within the budget to NEC public officials and dispatched or commissioned public officials." <<> Although the law stipulates that local government employees dispatched to the NEC during elections are also eligible for the special commendation allowance, in practice, NEC staff have monopolized it. This is because the NEC created a regulation on the payment of special commendation allowances under the NEC Act, limiting eligibility to NEC public officials of Grade 5 or lower. The 1.114 billion won from the last presidential election, 1.4 billion won from the 2024 general election, 1.097 billion won from the 2022 local elections, and 1.105 billion won from the 2022 presidential election were all paid exclusively to NEC staff. <<> Regarding the NEC staff's monopoly on special commendation allowances, the NABO pointed out in its settlement analysis report last year that it "does not align with the purpose of the NEC Act and raises issues of fairness in treatment between NEC staff and commissioned public officials." In response, the NEC revised the regulation in January this year to include secretaries and clerks of eup-myeon-dong election commissions, who are dispatched or commissioned during elections, as eligible recipients of the special commendation allowance. <<> However, the majority of local government employees who come to support during election periods are still excluded from receiving the special commendation allowance. Since they are only short-term commissioned as voting officers, counting officers, or voting management officials during voting and counting activities, they do not meet the 15-day service period required to be eligible for the monthly fixed-amount voting incentive payment. <<> Beyond the issue of fairness in the payment of special commendation allowances, the NABO pointed out that the fact that NEC staff receive such allowances itself is problematic. The NABO stated, "Questions have been raised about whether it is appropriate for NEC public officials, who are paid salaries by the state, to receive separate incentive payments in the form of special commendation allowances for performing their inherent duties of election management." The argument is that since managing elections is the basic job of NEC staff, there is no reason for them to receive additional incentives for doing so. The NABO added, "In the case of other public officials performing their inherent duties, such as police, firefighters, and military personnel, it is difficult to find examples where they receive a similar monthly fixed-amount incentive payment comparable to the NEC's system." <<> The NABO also noted, "The compensation system for public officials is divided into salary, allowances, and performance bonuses, but the special commendation allowance is paid outside this framework. Typically, public officials below Grade 5 receive overtime pay for work beyond regular hours, but the special commendation allowance is paid alongside this, raising issues of dual compensation." <<> The NABO suggested, "If compensation and encouragement for NEC public officials performing election duties are deemed necessary, it would be worth considering paying the allowance in the form of a bonus based on merit and performance reviews related to election work, rather than as a monthly fixed-amount special commendation allowance. Alternatively, a system could be examined where allowances are paid based on overtime work records. Given the problems raised regarding the NEC's poor election management, there is a need to reassess the necessity and method of paying the special commendation allowance." <<> Meanwhile, it has been revealed that the NEC diverted budget funds to pay special commendation allowances even during the June 3 local elections this year, where a shortage of ballot papers occurred. <<> According to data submitted by the National Election Commission to Rep. Yoon Gun-young of the Democratic Party of Korea on the 13th, the NEC's budget for special commendation allowance payments this year was set at approximately 3 billion won. However, with the expansion of eligible recipients in January, an additional 1 billion won or more was needed. In response, the NEC diverted budget from the 'general operating expenses' category to the special commendation allowance budget. A total of 10,339 people received 4,039,220,000 won. (국회예산정책처(예정처)가 지난 10일 공개한 2025회계연도 결산 분석 보고서에 따르면, 선관위는 선거 때마다 선관위 소속 공무원과 파견·위촉 공무원에게 ‘특별정려금(特別精勵金)’이라는 이름의 격려금을 지급하고 있다. 지난해 대선 때에는 4월부터 7월까지 4개월간 선관위 5급 공무원에게 한 달에 15만원씩 총 60만원, 6급 이하 공무원에게 한 달에 10만원씩 총 40만원을 줬다. 2628명이 총 11억1400만원을 받았다.)

item.title: Song Young-gil: “Fighting the president? In the old days, you’d be branded a traitor and beheaded...” Jeong Cheong-rae: “It’s chilling and frightening” (송영길 “대통령과 싸워? 옛날이면 역적으로 목을…” 정청래 “섬뜩하고 무섭다”)
item.description:
Song Young-gil: “Fighting the president? In the old days, you’d be branded a traitor and beheaded...” Jeong Cheong-rae: “It’s chilling and frightening” (송영길 “대통령과 싸워? 옛날이면 역적으로 목을…” 정청래 “섬뜩하고 무섭다”)

Song Young-gil, a lawmaker vying for leadership of the Democratic Party of Korea, and former party leader Jeong Cheong-rae clashed head-on, exchanging harsh words. After Song criticized the so-called “Myeong-Cheong War” — referring to the conflict between President Lee Jae-myung and Jeong — by saying, “In the old days, this would be a situation where we’d have to cut off traitors’ heads to suppress it,” Jeong fired back, saying, “It’s chilling and frightening.” (더불어민주당 당권 경쟁에 나선 송영길 의원과 정청래 전 대표가 거친 표현을 주고받으며 정면충돌했다. 송 의원이 이재명 대통령과 정 전 대표의 갈등을 뜻하는 이른바 ‘명청대전’을 비판하며 “옛날 같으면 역적으로 목을 잘라 진압해야 할 상황”이라고 말하자, 정 전 대표는 “섬뜩하고 무섭다”고 반발했다.)

During a meeting of the National Association of Honam Regional Associations in Yongsan-gu, Seoul, on the 14th, Song stated, “With four years left in the presidential term, it’s absurd that the ‘Myeong-Cheong War’ — a fight between the ruling party leader and the president — is dominating the front pages of newspapers every day.” (송 의원은 14일 서울 용산구 전국호남향우회 총연합회 간담회에서 “대통령 임기가 4년이나 남았는데 집권 여당 대표와 대통령이 싸운다는 ‘명청대전’이 매일 신문 1면을 장식하는 어이없는 일이 벌어지고 있다”고 말했다.)

He continued, “In the old days, this would be a situation where we’d have to cut off traitors’ heads and truly suppress them,” adding, “Since we live in a democratic society now, I can’t say that, but an unthinkable situation is unfolding.” These remarks were a critique of Jeong’s political moves, which have highlighted party-government conflicts rather than supporting the Lee Jae-myung administration’s governance. (이어 “옛날 같으면 역적으로 목을 잘라 정말 진압해야 할 상황”이라며 “지금은 민주주의 사회이기 때문에 그렇게 말할 수 없겠지만, 있을 수 없는 일이 벌어지고 있다”고 했다. 이재명 정부의 국정 운영을 뒷받침하기보다 당정 갈등을 부각해 온 정 전 대표의 정치 행보를 비판한 발언이다.)

Jeong immediately fired back on his Facebook page. He quoted Song’s comments and wrote, “Is running for party leadership such a life-threatening matter?” adding, “It’s chilling and frightening.” (정 전 대표는 곧바로 자신의 페이스북을 통해 맞받았다. 그는 송 의원의 발언을 인용한 뒤 “전당대회 출마가 목숨까지 위태로운 일입니까”라며 “섬뜩하고 무섭습니다”라고 밝혔다.)

The exchange between the two also spread into a debate over Song’s history of leaving the party. Appearing on CBS Radio’s “Park Sung-tae’s News Show” that day, Song refuted Jeong’s criticism of his past departure, saying, “My leaving the party was to protect the Democratic Party.” (두 사람의 공방은 송 의원의 탈당 이력을 둘러싼 논쟁으로도 번졌다. 송 의원은 이날 CBS 라디오 ‘박성태의 뉴스쇼’에 출연해 정 전 대표가 자신의 과거 탈당을 비판한 데 대해 “내 탈당은 민주당을 지키기 위한 탈당이었다”고 반박했다.)

Song brought up an incident from 2021, when he was the party leader, in which Jeong compared the collection of cultural property admission fees at a temple to the Korean folktale “Bong of Kim Seon-dal,” sparking fierce backlash from the Buddhist community. Song criticized Jeong’s actions as putting a burden on the party and the presidential candidate, failing to properly apologize, and sticking to his position until the end. He accused Jeong of prioritizing “Cheong-first, party-second” rather than “party-first, self-second.” (송 의원은 자신이 당 대표였던 2021년 정 전 대표가 사찰의 문화재 관람료 징수를 ‘봉이 김선달’에 빗대 불교계의 거센 반발을 불렀던 일을 거론했다. 그는 “당과 대선 후보에게 부담을 주면서도 제대로 사과하지 않고 끝까지 버텼다”며 정 전 대표의 행보를 ‘선당후사’가 아닌 ‘선청후당’이라고 비판했다.)

Song had left the Democratic Party in 2023 over allegations related to the cash envelopes incident in the party convention and was reinstated this year after being acquitted. He argued that his departure was a choice to reduce the party’s political burden, whereas Jeong, during his controversy, remained in the party and increased that burden. (송 의원은 민주당 전당대회 돈 봉투 사건 관련 혐의로 2023년 탈당한 뒤 올해 무죄가 확정돼 복당했다. 그는 자신의 탈당은 당의 정치적 부담을 줄이기 위한 선택이었던 반면, 정 전 대표는 논란 당시 당에 남아 부담을 키웠다는 논리를 폈다.)

Song also went on the offensive over Jeong’s announcement the previous day when he declared his candidacy for party leader, stating, “I will not use the position to run for president.” Song said, “It’s odd to talk about not running for president when four years remain in the presidential term,” adding, “What we need now is a ruling party leader who can join forces with the president to elevate South Korea to the next level.” (정 전 대표가 전날 당 대표 출마를 선언하며 “대표직을 이용해 대선에 출마하지 않겠다”고 밝힌 데 대해서도 공세를 이어갔다. 송 의원은 “대통령 임기가 4년이나 남은 상황에서 대선 불출마를 이야기하는 것 자체가 생뚱맞다”며 “대통령과 힘을 합쳐 대한민국을 한 단계 끌어올릴 집권당 대표가 필요한 시점”이라고 말했다.)

Song further claimed that Jeong stayed in the Honam region during the last presidential election to prepare for the party leadership race and pushed forward many of his close associates as candidates in local elections. He repeatedly criticized this as “thoroughly Cheong-first, party-second.” Specific rebuttals from Jeong’s side have not been publicly confirmed as of now. (송 의원은 정 전 대표가 지난 대선 기간 호남에 머물며 당 대표 선거를 준비했고, 지방선거 공천 과정에서 측근들을 대거 후보로 내세웠다는 주장도 내놨다. 그는 이를 두고 “철저한 선청후당이었다”고 거듭 비판했다. 정 전 대표 측의 구체적인 반박은 현재 공개적으로 확인되지 않았다.)

Meanwhile, the Democratic Party leadership decided at a supreme council meeting that day to amend party rules to allow a preferential voting system for the leadership election at the party convention on August 17. Under this system, if there are three or more candidates and no one secures a majority, the lowest-ranking candidate is eliminated, and the second-preference votes of voters who chose that candidate first are redistributed to the remaining candidates. (한편 민주당 지도부는 이날 최고위원회의에서 오는 8월 17일 전당대회 당 대표 경선에 선호투표제를 도입할 수 있도록 당규를 개정하기로 했다. 후보자가 3명 이상이고 과반 득표자가 나오지 않으면 최하위 후보를 탈락시킨 뒤, 해당 후보를 1순위로 선택한 유권자의 2순위 표를 남은 후보들에게 배분하는 방식이다.)

Song said, “Feel free to vote for Song Young-gil first,” adding, “If you then pick your next preferred person as the second choice, integration and unification will naturally happen.” In the preferential voting system, voters rank candidates by first and second preferences. If no candidate reaches a majority in the first tally, the lowest-ranking candidate is eliminated, and the votes of those who ranked them first are transferred to their second-preference candidate for the final count. (송 의원은 “마음 놓고 송영길을 찍어도 된다”며 “그다음 선호하는 사람을 2번으로 찍으면 자연스럽게 통합과 단일화가 이뤄진다”고 말했다. 선호투표제에서는 유권자가 후보별로 1순위와 2순위 등을 정해 투표하고, 1차 집계에서 과반 득표자가 나오지 않으면 최하위 후보를 탈락시킨 뒤 그 후보를 1순위로 선택한 표를 유권자가 적어 낸 2순위 후보에게 넘겨 합산시킨다.)

Consequently, if supporters of Song rank former Prime Minister Kim Min-seok as their second choice, and vice versa, then even if one is eliminated first, those votes can shift to the other candidate. Song’s remarks imply that even if the two candidates — often grouped as anti-Jeong or pro-Lee — do not formally unify, their respective support bases choosing the other as a secondary preference could funnel votes to one side in the final tally, effectively creating a de facto unification effect. (이에 따라 송 의원 지지자가 김민석 전 국무총리를 2순위로, 김 전 총리 지지자가 송 의원을 2순위로 선택할 경우 어느 한쪽이 먼저 탈락하더라도 해당 표가 다른 후보에게 이전될 수 있다. 송 의원의 발언은 반청 또는 친명계로 묶이는 두 후보가 공식적으로 단일화하지 않더라도 상호 지지층이 상대 후보를 차순위로 선택하면 최종 집계 과정에서 표가 한쪽으로 모여 사실상 단일화와 비슷한 효과를 낼 수 있다는 의미로 풀이된다.)
